title: Definitions and interpretation
summary: Provision relating to definitions and interpretation.

title: Definitions and interpretation - invention
summary: "invention" means a new product or process involving an inventive step and capable of industrial application.
notes: Fundamental definition establishing criteria for patentability.

title: Definitions and interpretation - inventive step
summary: "inventive step" means a feature of an invention that involves technical advance as compared to the existing knowledge or having economic significance or both and that makes the invention not obvious to a person skilled in the art.
notes: Critical for fighting patent applications that merely combine traditional knowledge.

title: What are not inventions
summary: Provision relating to what are not inventions.

title: What are not inventions - contrary to public order/morality
summary: An invention, the primary or intended use or commercial exploitation of which could be contrary to public order or morality or which causes serious prejudice to human, animal or plant life or health or to the environment.
notes: Used to protect plant life and environment.

title: What are not inventions - discovery of living thing or non-living substance
summary: The mere discovery of a scientific principle or the formulation of an abstract theory or discovery of any living thing or non-living substance occurring in nature.
notes: Directly prevents the patenting of naturally occurring medicinal plants and minerals.

title: What are not inventions - mere discovery of a new form of known substance
summary: The mere discovery of a new form of a known substance which does not result in the enhancement of the known efficacy of that substance or the mere discovery of any new property or new use for a known substance or of the mere use of a known process, machine or apparatus unless such known process results in a new product or employs at least one new reactant.
notes: Prevents patenting of new forms (like extracts) of known Ayurvedic substances unless significant efficacy enhancement is proven.

title: What are not inventions - mere admixture
summary: A substance obtained by a mere admixture resulting only in the aggregation of the properties of the components thereof or a process for producing such substance.
notes: Highly relevant for traditional Ayurvedic polyherbal formulations.

title: What are not inventions - traditional knowledge
summary: An invention which in effect, is traditional knowledge or which is an aggregation or duplication of known properties of traditionally known component or components.
notes: The most critical section for TKDL integration. Expressly prohibits patenting of TK.
